using CUDA, LinearAlgebra, JSON3
CUDA.allowscalar(false)
function main()
    r = Dict{String,Any}("device" => CUDA.name(CUDA.device()))
    try r["driver"] = string(CUDA.driver_version()) catch e; r["driver"]="?" end
    try r["runtime"] = string(CUDA.runtime_version()) catch e; r["runtime"]="?" end
    a = CUDA.CuArray(collect(1.0:16.0)); b = CUDA.CuArray(fill(2.0, 16))
    t(k, f) = try r[k] = f() catch e; r[k] = "ERR: " * first(sprint(showerror, e), 160) end
    t("dot_cublas",  () -> LinearAlgebra.dot(a, b))          # expects 272.0
    t("sum_bcast",   () -> sum(a .* b))
    t("mapreduce",   () -> mapreduce(*, +, a, b))
    t("sum_plain",   () -> sum(a))                            # expects 136.0
    t("cublas_gemv", () -> begin
        m = CUDA.CuArray(reshape(collect(1.0:16.0), 4, 4)); v = CUDA.CuArray(ones(4)); Array(m * v)
    end)
    println(JSON3.write(Dict("probe" => r)))
end
main()
